label: 💥 Unnest array
description: Explode an array column into rows — one row per element. The other columns are duplicated for each exploded row.

outputColumn.label: Output column name
outputColumn.help: Defaults to the original column name if blank.

preserveNulls.label: Preserve rows where array is NULL or empty
preserveNulls.help: On (default): rows with NULL / empty arrays produce a single row with NULL in the output column. Off: those rows are dropped entirely.
